name: shifting_ceratops_convolute_cannot_counter_it
notes: Printed: 'This spell can't be countered.' P1 responds with Convolute (counter unless its controller pays {4}); P0 spent all its mana, so the unless-cost is unpayable and never asked. Convolute resolves but the Ceratops is not countered and enters the battlefield. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
